claim: A list circulating in October 2026 names people connected to Jeffrey Epstein who have died. These entries cover 2014 to 2020. Official rulings are attributed to whoever made them, and where the list's dates or links differ from the record, the record is given. (1) Alfredo Rodriguez, Epstein's Palm Beach house manager in 2004–05, tried in 2009 to sell an address book of Epstein's contacts for $50,000 to a lawyer for Epstein's accusers. He was convicted of obstruction of justice, sentenced to 18 months, and died on December 28, 2014. (2) Wendy Leigh, a celebrity biographer, died in May 2016 at 65 in a fall from her riverside apartment in London; her agent gave no further details. In 2007 she wrote two Daily Mail articles on Ghislaine Maxwell and Epstein. A lawyer for Epstein's accusers later cited one in a court filing. Copies of both are in the DOJ Epstein release, one bearing a Palm Beach Police fax header. Whether she was researching Epstein in 2016 is not documented in the sources reviewed. (3) Joseph Recarey, the Palm Beach police detective who led the 2005–06 investigation of Epstein, died on May 25, 2018, at 50 after a brief illness. (4) Thomas Bowers, former head of Deutsche Bank's US private wealth-management unit, which oversaw Donald Trump's private banker, was found hanged at his Malibu home on November 19, 2019, not in April. The Los Angeles County coroner ruled it suicide. He appears once in the Epstein release, on an internal Deutsche Bank sheet listing him as the bank's Americas head. PolitiFact found no credible source for a separate claim that he was Epstein's personal banker. (5) Efrain Reyes became Epstein's cellmate at the Metropolitan Correctional Center in Manhattan on July 30, 2019. A transfer order dated August 8 moved him out on August 9, the day before Epstein was found dead. Reyes was found dead at 51 in his mother's New York apartment on November 27, 2020. The New York Daily News reported that he had caught COVID-19 in custody. A prosecutor's email in the release says he appeared to have died in his sleep and "may have been drug related, but perhaps not." No medical examiner's finding was published. (6) Steve Bing, a film producer and major Clinton Foundation donor, died on June 22, 2020 in a fall from his 27th-floor condominium in Century City, Los Angeles; his death was reported as a suicide. In the release he appears in press clippings and in a 2004 email from Clinton aide Doug Band to Maxwell: "Going out with steve bing later."

notes: Part 1 of 3 of a circulating Epstein death list, split by date for card length (part 2: 2026-epstein-death-list-002, 2022–2023; part 3: 2026-epstein-death-list-003, 2025–2026). The list's 1985 Arthur Shapiro entry is its own record: 1985-arthur-shapiro-epstein-lead-001.
